commands.name: list
commands.summary: Lists the books in the library with their title, author and whether each is on this device. Changes nothing.

query.description: Words to match against titles and authors; leave it out to list everything.

commands.name: open
commands.summary: Opens a book from the library in Gatefold, at the reading place kept for it, so the person sees it. Changes no text. Fails when the book is not on this device.

book.description: The book: its title as list_books shows it, or its id.

commands.name: sync
commands.summary: Sends the reading place of every book whose place is still waiting to be sent, now rather than later. Returns when the sending finishes.
